summary: A form field for picking a folder on disk, with a button that opens a folder picker.
description: A labeled, read-only text field paired with a moz-button that opens the native folder picker (nsIFilePicker). Resolves the chosen path to a real nsIFile via IOUtils and shows a folder icon (a real per-folder icon when the chrome Services module is available, otherwise a generic fallback) next to the value.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The path to the selected folder. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: displayValue
attributes.description: The value shown in the input, when it should differ from the real value.

attributes.name: dialogTitle
attributes.description: Text to display as the file-picker dialog's title.

attributes.name: folder
attributes.description: Read-only getter for the nsIFile representing the currently selected folder (or null). Not a settable property.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the component. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The readonly state of the input control; forced back to true on every update (willUpdate always resets it), since the value is only ever set via the folder picker, not typed directly.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The required state of the input control. Inherited from MozInputText.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon in the label. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page). Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text to display when the input has no value. Inherited from MozInputText.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner input. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Inherited from MozBaseInputElement: rendered when the description property is unset, letting callers supply richer description markup.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Inherited from MozBaseInputElement: rendered when supportPage is unset, letting callers supply a custom support link element.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Own slot alongside the choose-folder button, for additional actions.

events.name: input
events.description: Native Event (bubbles) dispatched by openFolderPicker() after a folder is chosen, since the field itself is readonly and not directly typed into.

events.name: change
events.description: Native Event (bubbles) dispatched by openFolderPicker() after a folder is chosen.

events.name: moz-input-folder-picker-close
events.description: Test-only CustomEvent dispatched (only when Cu.isInAutomation) when the picker dialog closes without a value change, so tests can wait for the dialog to finish closing.

methods.name: hasServices
methods.description: Safely reports whether the privileged Services module is available in this context.

methods.name: getFolderFromPath
methods.description: Resolves a filesystem path string to a real nsIFile/IOUtils directory object.

methods.name: getInputIconSrc
methods.description: Computes the moz-icon:// URL for a given folder, or a generic folder icon fallback.

methods.name: openFolderPicker
methods.description: Opens the native folder picker (nsIFilePicker) and, if a new folder is chosen, updates value/folder and dispatches input/change.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The internal <label is="moz-label">, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().

cssParts.name: support-link
cssParts.description: The optional support link, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().
